item.title: Hackers abuse refrigeration controllers to send spam and route proxy traffic
item.description: Internet-exposed refrigeration controllers used in supermarkets and cold storage facilities are being hijacked and turned into infrastructure for a suspected spam botnet and proxy services, SecurityScorecard has found.
